name: The Empty River
pitch: A hermit lives in a painting that sects buy and stamp: walk in and each brushstroke makes you smaller until you are a dot on a far path.

new.name: Empty River
new.effect: A named scroll that is the ground: no slot, no thần thức. Paper 100, fading 5 Blank a season. Reached only by being painted in.

new.name: Far Distance
new.effect: An art with the ink tag makes the target smaller by 1 % per point of ink, to 20 %. Size scales fight unit, health and linh lực. Way of Space.

new.name: The Blank
new.effect: Ink arts are paid in paper at 100 points per share of cost, never in linh lực, and it does not return in a fight.

new.name: Collector's Seal
new.effect: Each seal takes Blank and adds points to one layer for every hit inside.

new.name: Signed and Dated
new.effect: +1 L2 on the Signature per point of Blank painted.
new.second_home: any finishing art that reads a spent pool

new.name: The Far Bank
new.effect: Way of Space (Không Gian Đạo), a catalogue seed with no tree. Water at purity 40. Branches The Near Bank, The Middle Reach, The Far Bank. Keystone Far Distance. Only this branch's signature nodes are written.

new.name: Signature
new.effect: Qi, c_art 2.1, cost 0.05, 3 s, guarded on 9 Blank or fewer.

new.name: Size
new.effect: A fight value on a side that scales its fight unit and both pools, bounded at 20 %.

questions: Is Size too strong a rule to sit on a keystone, and should a loser carry it for a season after the fight?
A forgery at half shrink wins every run because a hermit spends the whole tree on fighting. Should someone with no outside life get that W?
The biggest stroke always wins, as the cheapest art does on the common ward. Is that the same lint question?
